name: 2 Tentacles
description: The creature has 2 tentacles. It gains one Free Attack per tentacle, inflicting SB+0 Damage. If a tentacle causes Damage, the target gains an Entangled Condition and is Grappled by that tentacle. Use the tentacle's Free Attack, not the creature's Action, to resolve that Grapple.

name: 8 Tentacles
description: The creature has 8 tentacles. It gains one Free Attack per tentacle, inflicting SB+0 Damage. If a tentacle causes Damage, the target gains an Entangled Condition and is Grappled by that tentacle. Use the tentacle's Free Attack, not the creature's Action, to resolve that Grapple.

name: Afraid - Elves
description: Creature fears Elves. On meeting them it makes an Extended Psychology Test; until its SL reaches their Fear Rating it cannot gain Momentum, and Elves attacking it in melee benefit from Advantage.

name: Amphibious
description: Has the Swim Skill and gains +1 SL to all Swim Tests. Can move through water with full Movement.

name: Animosity - Elves
description: Creature dislikes Elves. On meeting them it makes a Psychology Test; on a failure it must attack them socially or physically and gains +1 SL to Fellowship-based Tests to oppose or belittle them.

name: Animosity - Orcs and Goblins
description: Creature dislikes Orcs and Goblins. On meeting them it makes a Psychology Test; on a failure it must attack them socially or physically and gains +1 SL to Fellowship-based Tests to oppose or belittle them.

name: Belligerent
description: While the creature has Momentum, it is immune to Fear.

name: Bestial
description: The creature has no reason or language. It gains a Broken Condition if wounded by fire. It defends only with Dodge. If it loses more than half its Wounds, it will attempt to Flee, unless it is protecting young, is cornered or is Territorial, in which case it enters Frenzy instead.

name: Bite 1
description: Can lose Momentum to make a Free Attack inflicting 1 Damage. The attack does not take Strength Bonus into account.

name: Bite 4
description: Can lose Momentum to make a Free Attack inflicting 4 Damage. The attack does not take Strength Bonus into account.

name: Bite 5
description: Can lose Momentum to make a Free Attack inflicting 5 Damage. The attack does not take Strength Bonus into account.

name: Bite 6
description: Can lose Momentum to make a Free Attack inflicting 6 Damage. The attack does not take Strength Bonus into account.

name: Bite 8
description: Can lose Momentum to make a Free Attack inflicting 8 Damage. The attack does not take Strength Bonus into account.

name: Bite 9
description: Can lose Momentum to make a Free Attack inflicting 9 Damage. The attack does not take Strength Bonus into account.

name: Blessed - Rhya
description: Creature can enact Rhya Blessings. It has the Pray Skill at Fel +10 (or more, at the GM's discretion).

name: Bounce
description: Double Movement when Charging, Leaping or Sprinting. Can jump over intervening terrain and creatures.

name: Breath - Acid
description:
Free Attack (ranged). Target 1 creature within 20+TB yards; all creatures within SB yards of it are also struck. Perform an Opposed Ballistic Skill/Dodge Test against every target with a single roll (a creature without BS counts as BS 30). The creature is immune to its own Breath. The attack is Magical.
Acid: losing targets take TB+4 Damage and their weapons and armour suffer 1 Damage.

name: Breath - Cold
description:
Free Attack (ranged). Target 1 creature within 20+TB yards; all creatures within SB yards of it are also struck. Perform an Opposed Ballistic Skill/Dodge Test against every target with a single roll (a creature without BS counts as BS 30). The creature is immune to its own Breath. The attack is Magical.
Cold: losing targets take SB+2 Damage and gain a Fatigued Condition; until it is removed, their weapons gain the Slow Flaw.

name: Breath - Electricity
description:
Free Attack (ranged). Target 1 creature within 20+TB yards; all creatures within SB yards of it are also struck. Perform an Opposed Ballistic Skill/Dodge Test against every target with a single roll (a creature without BS counts as BS 30). The creature is immune to its own Breath. The attack is Magical.
Electricity: losing targets take SB+2 Damage, ignoring metal armour, and gain a Stunned Condition.

name: Breath - Fire
description:
Free Attack (ranged). Target 1 creature within 20+TB yards; all creatures within SB yards of it are also struck. Perform an Opposed Ballistic Skill/Dodge Test against every target with a single roll (a creature without BS counts as BS 30). The creature is immune to its own Breath. The attack is Magical.
Fire: losing targets take SB+3 Damage and gain an Ablaze Condition.

name: Breath - Poison
description:
Free Attack (ranged). Target 1 creature within 20+TB yards; all creatures within SB yards of it are also struck. Perform an Opposed Ballistic Skill/Dodge Test against every target with a single roll (a creature without BS counts as BS 30). The creature is immune to its own Breath. The attack is Magical.
Poison: losing targets take TB+2 Damage and gain a Poisoned Condition.

name: Breath - Smoke
description:
Free Attack (ranged). Target 1 creature within 20+TB yards; all creatures within SB yards of it are also struck. Perform an Opposed Ballistic Skill/Dodge Test against every target with a single roll (a creature without BS counts as BS 30). The creature is immune to its own Breath. The attack is Magical.
Smoke: the area fills with smoke that blocks line of sight and causes Suffocation for TB Rounds.

name: Champion
description: When defending in melee, if the creature wins an Opposed Test, it causes Damage as if it were the attacker.

name: Chill Grasp
description: The creature can lose Momentum to use its Action for an Opposed Weapon Skill/Melee or Dodge Test. If it wins, the target loses 1d10 + SL Wounds, ignoring TB and AP. The attack is Magical.

name: Cold-blooded
description: Gains Advantage to Cool Tests. When it gains the Surprised Condition, the Condition is not removed the first time it normally would be.

name: Constrictor
description: Targets gets an Entangled Condition on every successful hit. The creature can then enter a Grapple.

name: Construct
description: The creature is a magical construct. It has no Int, WP or Fel and never Tests them; use T instead of WP when a Test is required. Without a spellcaster controlling it or the Territorial Trait, it wanders aimlessly. When calculating its Wounds, use SB in place of WB. All its attacks are Magical.

name: Corrosive Blood
description: Every time the creature is wounded, all targets Engaged with it take 1d10 Damage (one roll for all targets).

name: Corruption - Minor
description: Creature is a Corrupting Influence of Minor strength.

name: Corruption - Moderate
description: Creature is a Corrupting Influence of Moderate strength.

name: Daemonic 8
description: Creature does not need food, drink, air, etc. All its attacks are Magical. Every time it is hit, roll 1d10; on 8 or higher the blow is ignored, even a Critical, unless the blow is Magical. When reduced to 0 Wounds, the creature is removed from play.

name: Dark Vision
description: Creature can see in the dark as well as in daylight.

name: Disease - Packer's Pox
description: The creature has the Packer's Pox.

name: Disease - Ratte Fever
description: The creature has the Ratte Fever.

name: Disease - The Black Plague
description: The creature has the Black Plague.

name: Distracting
description: All living targets within TB yards suffer -2 SL to all Tests. Does not stack if there are multiple Distracting creatures around.

name: Ethereal
description: The creature is insubstantial. It can pass through solid objects and can be damaged only by Magical attacks. All its attacks are Magical.

name: Fear 1
description: Causes Fear 1. Opponents make an Extended Psychology Test; until they score more than 1 SL in total they cannot gain Momentum, and melee attacks against them benefit from Advantage.

name: Fly 10
description: As its Move, the creature can fly up to 10 yards, ignoring terrain, obstacles and creatures, and may Charge this way. If it starts its turn flying, it must Fly as its Move. Ranged attacks against it increase range by 1 step. When flying, it gets -20 penalty to its own Ranged Attacks. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 358

name: Fly 100
description: As its Move, the creature can fly up to 100 yards, ignoring terrain, obstacles and creatures, and may Charge this way. If it starts its turn flying, it must Fly as its Move. Ranged attacks against it increase range by 1 step. When flying, it gets -20 penalty to its own Ranged Attacks. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 358

name: Fly 20
description: As its Move, the creature can fly up to 20 yards, ignoring terrain, obstacles and creatures, and may Charge this way. If it starts its turn flying, it must Fly as its Move. Ranged attacks against it increase range by 1 step. When flying, it gets -20 penalty to its own Ranged Attacks. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 358

name: Fly 40
description: As its Move, the creature can fly up to 40 yards, ignoring terrain, obstacles and creatures, and may Charge this way. If it starts its turn flying, it must Fly as its Move. Ranged attacks against it increase range by 1 step. When flying, it gets -20 penalty to its own Ranged Attacks. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 358

name: Fly 80
description: As its Move, the creature can fly up to 80 yards, ignoring terrain, obstacles and creatures, and may Charge this way. If it starts its turn flying, it must Fly as its Move. Ranged attacks against it increase range by 1 step. When flying, it gets -20 penalty to its own Ranged Attacks. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 358

name: Frenzy
description: Creature can enter Frenzy

name: Ghostly Howl
description: Once per turn, the creature can lose Momentum to howl as a Free Attack. All living targets within S yards that hear it gain 3 Deafened Conditions and suffer 1d10 Wounds ignoring TB and AP. They must also pass an Average (+2 SL) Cool Test or gain a Broken Condition. The attack is Magical.

name: Grim
description: If the creature has no Momentum at the end of its turn, it gains Momentum.

name: Hatred - Daemons of Khorne
description: Creature hates Daemons of Khorne. On meeting them it makes a Psychology Test; on a failure it must attack them by the fastest and deadliest means, gains +1 SL to Melee and Ranged Tests against them, and is immune to their Intimidate and Fear (but not Terror).

name: Hatred - Daemons of Slaanesh
description: Creature hates Daemons of Slaanesh. On meeting them it makes a Psychology Test; on a failure it must attack them by the fastest and deadliest means, gains +1 SL to Melee and Ranged Tests against them, and is immune to their Intimidate and Fear (but not Terror).

name: Hatred - Dwarfs
description: Creature hates Dwarfs. On meeting them it makes a Psychology Test; on a failure it must attack them by the fastest and deadliest means, gains +1 SL to Melee and Ranged Tests against them, and is immune to their Intimidate and Fear (but not Terror).

name: Hatred - Elves
description: Creature hates Elves. On meeting them it makes a Psychology Test; on a failure it must attack them by the fastest and deadliest means, gains +1 SL to Melee and Ranged Tests against them, and is immune to their Intimidate and Fear (but not Terror).

name: Hatred - Living
description: Creature hates the Living. On meeting them it makes a Psychology Test; on a failure it must attack them by the fastest and deadliest means, gains +1 SL to Melee and Ranged Tests against them, and is immune to their Intimidate and Fear (but not Terror).

name: Hatred - Orcs and Goblins
description: Creature hates Orcs and Goblins. On meeting them it makes a Psychology Test; on a failure it must attack them by the fastest and deadliest means, gains +1 SL to Melee and Ranged Tests against them, and is immune to their Intimidate and Fear (but not Terror).

name: Hatred - Predators
description: Creature hates Predators. On meeting them it makes a Psychology Test; on a failure it must attack them by the fastest and deadliest means, gains +1 SL to Melee and Ranged Tests against them, and is immune to their Intimidate and Fear (but not Terror).

name: Horns
description: When the creature Charges, it may make a Free Attack with its Horns (or a similar sharp feature, e.g. tusks) inflicting SB+4 Damage.

name: Hungry
description: If the creature kills or incapacitates a living opponent (or finds a fresh body), it must pass an Average (+2 SL) Cool Test or feast, losing its next Move and Action.

name: Immune to Psychology
description: This creature ignores the Psychology rules.

name: Immunity - Fire
description: This creature is completely immune to Fire Damage, including Critical Wounds caused by it.

name: Immunity - Poison
description: This creature is completely immune to Poison Damage, including Critical Wounds caused by it.

name: Infected
description: When the creature causes a living opponent to lose Wounds, the victim has to pass an Easy (+4 SL) Endurance Test or contract a Festering Wound.

name: Infestation
description: All opponents suffer -1 SL to hit it in melee combat.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Casting Tests for spells that would affect the creature suffer -3 SL. A creature with this Trait cannot have the Channelling Skill or the Arcane Magic, Bless, Chaos Magic, Invoke, Petty Magic or Witch! Talents.

name: Magical
description: Creature's attacks count as Magical.

name: Many Heads
description: The creature has several heads. Critical Wounds to the head that would stun, kill or knock it out only take effect once every head is affected. With Bite, Horns or Tongue it can make one Free Attack per healthy head. Gains +2 SL to Perception Tests while it has at least two healthy heads.

name: Mark of Chaos - Khorne
description: The creature bears the Mark of Khorne. It gains the Frenzy and Etiquette (Followers of Khorne) Talents. It has Animosity towards overt followers of Slaanesh, and they towards it while the Mark is visible. It cannot use Language (Magick) or Channelling except to dispel. It may buy Berserk Charge, Combat Aware, Combat Reflexes, Furious Assault, Implacable, Magic Resistance, Resistance (Magic), Resolute, Strike Mighty Blow and Warrior Born as Career Advances.

name: Mark of Chaos - Nurgle
description: The creature bears the Mark of Nurgle. Gains +10 T and the Etiquette (Followers of Nurgle) Talent. It has Animosity towards overt followers of Tzeentch, and they towards it while the Mark is visible. It may buy Frightening, Hardy, Implacable, Iron Jaw, Menacing, Resistance (Poison), Resistance (Disease), Robust, Tenacious and Very Resilient as Career Advances.

name: Mark of Chaos - Slaanesh
description: Bearing the brand of Slaanesh, the creature gains the Fearless - Everything and Etiquette - Followers of Slaanesh Talents. It suffers Animosity towards obvious followers of Khorne, and Khorne followers suffer Animosity towards it as long as the Mark of Slaanesh is visible. It may also purchase the following Talents at standard XP cost as if they were Career Advances: Attractive, Blather, Careful Strike, Combat Master, Gregarious, Inspiring, Lightning Reflexes, Nimblefingered, Resistant - Poison, and Sharp.

name: Mark of Chaos - Tzeentch
description: The creature bears the Mark of Tzeentch. It gains 1d10/3 Mutations (round up), alternating Mental and Physical, and the Etiquette (Followers of Tzeentch) Talent. It has Animosity towards overt followers of Nurgle, and they towards it while the Mark is visible. It may buy Aethyric Attunement, Arcane Magic (Any), Chaos Magic (Tzeentch), Fast Hands, Instinctive Diction, Magical Sense, Petty Magic, Second Sight, War Wizard and Witch! as Career Advances.

name: Mental Corruption
description: Creature gains a random Mental Mutation.

name: Miracles - Rhya
description: Creature can enact Rhya Miracles. It has the Pray Skill at Fel +10 (or more, at the GM's discretion).

name: Mutation
description: Creature gains a random Physical Mutation.

name: Night Vision
description: Creature sees clearly in natural darkness up to 20 yards and extends the illumination of any light source by 20 yards.

name: Painless
description: Creature ignores all non-amputation penalties from Critical Wounds. Conditions are suffered as normal.

name: Petrifying Gaze
description: As an Action, lose Momentum to perform an Opposed Ballistic Skill/Initiative Test (or Language (Magick) instead of Initiative) against one living target in sight. Inflicts 1 Stunned Condition, +1 per SL after the first. If the creature wins by 6 or more SL, the target is permanently turned into stone.

name: Regeneration
description: If the creature has more than 0 Wounds, at the beginning of each turn, it regenerates 1d10 Wounds. If it has 0 Wounds, it can regenerate 1 Wound if it rolls 8+ on 1d10. On every 10 roll it can regenerate 1 Critical Wound. Wounds (normal and Critical) caused by fire cannot be regenerated.

name: Size - Average
description: Creature size is Average. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 360-361

name: Size - Enormous
description: Creature size is Enormous. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 360-361

name: Size - Large
description: Creature size is Large. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 360-361

name: Size - Little
description: Creature size is Little. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 360-361

name: Size - Monstrous
description: Creature size is Monstrous. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 360-361

name: Size - Small
description: Creature size is Small. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 360-361

name: Size - Tiny
description: Creature size is Tiny. See detailed rules in WFRP 5e p. 360-361

name: Skittish
description: Gets easily startled by Magic or loud noises. If that happens, it receives +3 Broken Conditions.

name: Spellcaster - Lore of Death
description: Creature can cast spells from the Lore of Death. Add the Spellcaster or Spellcaster Lord template or, if not appropriate, Channelling (WP +10) and Language (Magick) (Int +10).

name: Spellcaster - Lore of Fire
description: Creature can cast spells from the Lore of Fire. Add the Spellcaster or Spellcaster Lord template or, if not appropriate, Channelling (WP +10) and Language (Magick) (Int +10).

name: Spellcaster - Necromancy
description: Creature can cast spells from the Lore of Necromancy. Add the Spellcaster or Spellcaster Lord template or, if not appropriate, Channelling (WP +10) and Language (Magick) (Int +10).

name: Sprinter
description: Running speed is increased by 50%.

name: Stealthy
description: Has the Stealth (Rural) Skill at Ag +10 (or more, at the GM's discretion).

name: Striding Gait - Mountains
description: Creature suffers no movement penalties in mountains and gains +1 SL to Athletics and Stealth Tests there.

name: Striding Gait - Underground
description: Creature suffers no movement penalties in underground and gains +1 SL to Athletics and Stealth Tests there.

name: Striding Gait - Wetlands
description: Creature suffers no movement penalties in wetlands and gains +1 SL to Athletics and Stealth Tests there.

name: Striding Gait - Woodland
description: Creature suffers no movement penalties in woodland and gains +1 SL to Athletics and Stealth Tests there.

name: Stupid
description: If the creature is not near allies without this Trait, it must pass an Easy (+4 SL) Intelligence Test at the start of each Round. If it fails, it loses both its Move and Action for that Turn.

name: Swarm
description: The swarm counts as a single creature. Ignores Psychology and Size rules, and the Engaged rules when moving. All Engaged opponents lose 1 Wound at the end of every Round. The swarm has 5 times more Wounds than a single creature and +10 WS. Ranged attacks against the swarm have +40 to hit.

name: Tail
description: Can lose Momentum to make a tail Free Attack inflicting SB+2 Damage. A smaller target that loses any Wounds also gains a Prone Condition.

name: Territorial
description: The creature will fight to the death to protect its territory and will not chase anything beyond it.

name: Terror 1
description: Causes Terror 1. On first encounter, opponents make a Psychology Test; on a failure they gain 1 Broken Condition, +1 per negative SL. The creature also causes Fear 1.

name: Terror 3
description: Causes Terror 3. On first encounter, opponents make a Psychology Test; on a failure they gain 3 Broken Conditions, +1 per negative SL. The creature also causes Fear 3.

name: Tongue
description: Can lose Momentum to make a ranged Free Attack with its tongue, inflicting SB+0 Damage (default range 3 yards for Small to Large creatures, 12 yards for bigger ones). If the target is hit, it receives 1 Entangled Condition. If the target is smaller, it is also dragged into melee with the creature, which can then release it, Grapple it, or make a Free Attack using its Weapon Trait.

name: Tracker
description: Has the Track Skill at Int +10 (or more, at the GM's discretion).

name: Trained - Broken
description:
Animal has been trained using Animal Training Skill.
Broken - ignores Bestial, gains 2d10 Fel.

name: Trained - Drive
description:
Animal has been trained using Animal Training Skill.
Drive - trained to pull a cart , coach, etc.

name: Trained - Entertain
description:
Animal has been trained using Animal Training Skill.
Entertain - gets +10 to Entertain, Perform or Play Tests.

name: Trained - Fetch
description:
Animal has been trained using Animal Training Skill.
Fetch - can fetch small items on command.

name: Trained - Guard
description:
Animal has been trained using Animal Training Skill.
Guard - gains Territorial Trait.

name: Trained - Home
description:
Animal has been trained using Animal Training Skill.
Home - trained to return home if lost.

name: Trained - Magic
description:
Animal has been trained using Animal Training Skill.
Magic - ignores Skittish when it comes to magic.

name: Trained - Mount
description:
Animal has been trained using Animal Training Skill.
Mount - can be mounted by a rider with correct skill.

name: Trained - War
description:
Animal has been trained using Animal Training Skill.
War - Gains +10 WS and ignores Skittish when it comes to loud noises.

name: Undead
description: Creature is an Undead.

name: Unstable
description: Whenever the creature ends a Round Engaged with any opponent who has Momentum while it has none, it loses 2 Wounds. At 0 Wounds it is destroyed or banished.

name: Vampiric
description: On successful Bite attack, heal number of Wounds equal to the number of Wounds lost by the target. This is the only way the creature can heal.

name: Venom - Average
description: When the creature causes any Wound, the target receives 1 Poisoned Condition that requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance Test to remove.

name: Venom - Challenging
description: When the creature causes any Wound, the target receives 1 Poisoned Condition that requires Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test to remove.

name: Venom - Difficult
description: When the creature causes any Wound, the target receives 1 Poisoned Condition that requires Difficult (-2 SL) Endurance Test to remove.

name: Vomit
description: If the creature starts its Turn engaged in combat, it can give up its Move and Action to Vomit. It performs an Opposed Ballistic Skill/Dodge Test against all targets within 2 yards; the Test is Easy (+4 SL) for the creature and Challenging (+0 SL) for the targets. Losing targets are hit with TB+4 Damage, receive a Stunned Condition, and all their armour and weapons suffer 1 Damage. Can Vomit only once every 12 hours.

name: Wallcrawler
description: Can move at full speed on any wall or ceiling. Automatically passes all Climb Tests.

name: Ward 10
description: Roll 1d10 after any blow. If the creatures rolls 10, it ignores all Damage.

name: Ward 8
description: Roll 1d10 after any blow. If the creatures rolls 8, 9, or 10, it ignores all Damage.

name: Ward 9
description: Roll 1d10 after any blow. If the creatures rolls 9 or 10, it ignores all Damage.

name: Web 1
description: On every successful hit, the opponent receives 1 Entangled Condition with strength 1.

name: Web 40
description: On every successful hit, the opponent receives 1 Entangled Condition with strength 40.
